title: RowWriteRequest
description: Request body for both POST (append) and PUT (replace) /api/data-sources/:id/rows (HEL-1077). `rows` is a positional row array -- each row itself an array of cell values positionally aligned to the source's declared column order, matching the shape `DatasetRowValidator`/`dataset_rows.data` already use (never object-keyed). An empty array is rejected with 400 on POST but is a valid 'clear all rows' request on PUT -- that distinction is enforced server-side, not by this schema.
